title: Storyboard: a character sheet is one character - per-picture 'several characters' switch and per-model reference wording
description: Fabio 2026-10-27: panel 1 of his robot-crew board drew six robots from five references. The plan and prompt were right (five named, headcount line); each reference is a Character Sheet showing the robot three times. Cropping the sheet is rejected (he uses sheets because a single front view loses the side and back). Fix by prompting: tell the panel model each picture is ONE character seen from several sides, in the wording each panel model wants (FLUX.3 Klein per BFL's guide, Qwen-Image 2.1 its own). In step 2 (Your pictures) each picture gets a switch 'Several characters': off (default) = one character, possibly a sheet; on = a group picture. Test-first, bench on the local GPU (free).
